If you feel that someone is exercising a particular gift of the Spirit in a wrong way, instead of criticizing it, demonstrate in your own life or in your own church the right way to do it. And we're not to be among the fools who merely criticize. And the only one who has the right to expose something wrong is the one who is doing it in the right way himself. Do you feel that the gift of tongues, for example, is being abused in some place? Maybe you're right.
